scenario: Quanta Devices held its quarterly earnings call to discuss results of operations. The call was a regularly scheduled, previously announced call, and Quanta had already furnished its earnings press release before the call. The only disclosure at issue is the results-of-operations information conveyed on that call.
policy: A company must disclose a reportable event on Form 8-K within four business days of the triggering event, except that disclosure of the company's results of operations and financial condition under Item 2.02 is not required to be filed within four business days when the information is released solely through a regularly scheduled earnings call that has been previously announced and the related earnings press release was already furnished.
question: Is Quanta required to file a separate Form 8-K for the results-of-operations information within four business days of the call?
